# 🧠 300+ Advanced Open-Source Repositories for Professional & Senior Engineers [2026]

No fluff, no beginner detours - just the repositories senior engineers actually reach for. 🧠⚙️
Distributed systems, cloud-native infra, the full LLM-engineering stack, and a serious security arsenal.

--- > **A deep, battle-tested catalog of 300+ production-grade repositories for senior software engineers, staff engineers, SREs, platform & infrastructure engineers, security engineers, ML/AI engineers, and data engineers.** > > **🎯 Audience: Professionals & Advanced.** This is the "senior engineer" companion to the [280+ comprehensive list](../README.md) (for everyone) and the [150 essentials list](../awesome-learn-to-code/README.md) (for beginners & students). Everything here assumes you already ship software - it's about depth: distributed systems, cloud-native infra, observability, LLM engineering, and offensive/defensive security. > **🗓️ Curated on 21 July 2026** from live research across GitHub Trending, the CNCF landscape, Papers-we-Love, and practitioner communities. Every link is a real, canonical GitHub repository. --- ## 📍 Table of Contents - [🏛️ System Design & Distributed Systems](#-system-design--distributed-systems) - [🗄️ Databases & Storage Engines](#-databases--storage-engines) - [🌊 Data Engineering & Pipelines](#-data-engineering--pipelines) - [📡 Message Queues, Streaming & Event-Driven](#-message-queues-streaming--event-driven) - [⚡ LLM Serving & Inference](#-llm-serving--inference) - [🧩 LLM App Frameworks & Orchestration](#-llm-app-frameworks--orchestration) - [🤖 AI Agents & Multi-Agent Systems](#-ai-agents--multi-agent-systems) - [🔎 RAG, Vector Databases & Agent Memory](#-rag-vector-databases--agent-memory) - [🎛️ Model Fine-Tuning & Training](#-model-fine-tuning--training) - [🧪 LLM Evaluation, Observability & Guardrails](#-llm-evaluation-observability--guardrails) - [📦 MLOps & Experiment Tracking](#-mlops--experiment-tracking) - [⚙️ DevOps & Infrastructure-as-Code](#-devops--infrastructure-as-code) - [☸️ Kubernetes & Cloud-Native](#-kubernetes--cloud-native) - [🔭 Observability & SRE](#-observability--sre) - [🧵 Backend Frameworks & API Tooling](#-backend-frameworks--api-tooling) - [🕸️ Networking, Proxies & Service Mesh](#-networking-proxies--service-mesh) - [🏎️ Performance, Load Testing & Chaos](#-performance-load-testing--chaos) - [🏗️ Platform Engineering & Internal Developer Platforms](#-platform-engineering--internal-developer-platforms) - [🛡️ Security, AppSec & Offensive/Defensive](#-security-appsec--offensivedefensive) - [🦀 Systems Languages, Runtimes & Containers](#-systems-languages-runtimes--containers) - [🎨 Advanced Frontend & Build Tooling](#-advanced-frontend--build-tooling) - [📱 Advanced Mobile](#-advanced-mobile) - [🚀 2026 Breakouts (Pro Picks)](#-2026-breakouts-pro-picks) --- ## 🏛️ System Design & Distributed Systems - [System Design Primer](https://github.com/donnemartin/system-design-primer) - The canonical open-source guide to scaling systems, with deep treatment of caching, sharding, and consistency trade-offs. - [System Design 101](https://github.com/ByteByteGoHq/system-design-101) - ByteByteGo's visual explainers of real-world architectures used as shared vocabulary in design reviews. - [System Design (karanpratapsingh)](https://github.com/karanpratapsingh/system-design) - A book-length treatment of scalability, distributed patterns, and failure modes beyond interview trivia. - [Awesome Scalability](https://github.com/binhnguyennus/awesome-scalability) - A curated firehose of engineering blog posts and papers on reliable, performant large-scale systems. - [Awesome System Design Resources](https://github.com/ashishps1/awesome-system-design-resources) - Concise reference of distributed-systems building blocks and case studies kept current for practitioners. - [Distributed Systems Topics](https://github.com/Sairyss/distributed-systems-topics) - A dense index of microservices, scalability, and reliability topics with authoritative sources. - [Jepsen](https://github.com/jepsen-io/jepsen) - Kyle Kingsbury's framework for verifying distributed database consistency under partitions; the industry standard for correctness testing. - [PingCAP Talent Plan](https://github.com/pingcap/talent-plan) - Hands-on courses that have you build a real distributed KV store and SQL layer in Rust/Go. - [Papers We Love](https://github.com/papers-we-love/papers-we-love) - A community repo of foundational CS papers (consensus, storage, concurrency) for first principles. - [Awesome Distributed Systems](https://github.com/theanalyst/awesome-distributed-systems) - A tightly curated list of the seminal talks, papers, and books on distributed computing. - [Awesome Software Architecture](https://github.com/mehdihadeli/awesome-software-architecture) - Deep, categorized resources on DDD, CQRS, event sourcing, and clean/hexagonal architecture. - [Awesome Distributed System Projects](https://github.com/roma-glushko/awesome-distributed-system-projects) - Real open-source distributed systems organized for studying production implementations. ## 🗄️ Databases & Storage Engines - [PostgreSQL](https://github.com/postgres/postgres) - The official mirror of the world's most advanced open-source RDBMS, the default backend for serious systems. - [CockroachDB](https://github.com/cockroachdb/cockroach) - A distributed SQL database with serializable isolation and survivability, prized for global consistency without manual sharding. - [TiDB](https://github.com/pingcap/tidb) - A horizontally scalable HTAP database with MySQL compatibility for mixed transactional/analytical workloads. - [Vitess](https://github.com/vitessio/vitess) - The MySQL sharding and clustering system that powers YouTube and Slack. - [YugabyteDB](https://github.com/yugabyte/yugabyte-db) - A Postgres-compatible distributed SQL database for resilient, geo-distributed deployments. - [ScyllaDB](https://github.com/scylladb/scylladb) - A C++ Cassandra-compatible store with a shard-per-core architecture delivering predictable low latency. - [TiKV](https://github.com/tikv/tikv) - A CNCF-graduated distributed transactional key-value store (Raft + Percolator). - [Apache Cassandra](https://github.com/apache/cassandra) - The battle-tested wide-column store for write-heavy, multi-datacenter workloads. - [ClickHouse](https://github.com/ClickHouse/ClickHouse) - The fastest open-source columnar OLAP database, the default for real-time analytics over billions of rows. - [DuckDB](https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb) - An in-process analytical database ("SQLite for analytics") ubiquitous in data pipelines. - [Apache Doris](https://github.com/apache/doris) - A high-performance real-time MPP analytical database for sub-second queries. - [TimescaleDB](https://github.com/timescale/timescaledb) - A Postgres extension turning it into a scalable time-series database with hypertables. - [InfluxDB](https://github.com/influxdata/influxdb) - A purpose-built time-series database and platform for metrics and events at scale. - [QuestDB](https://github.com/questdb/questdb) - A high-throughput time-series database with SQL and nanosecond timestamps. - [VictoriaMetrics](https://github.com/VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaMetrics) - A fast, cost-efficient time-series database and long-term Prometheus store. - [PgBouncer](https://github.com/pgbouncer/pgbouncer) - The lightweight Postgres connection pooler, essentially mandatory for serverless and high-concurrency backends. - [Patroni](https://github.com/zalando/patroni) - The de facto template for Postgres high availability and automated failover. - [RocksDB](https://github.com/facebook/rocksdb) - Facebook's embeddable LSM-tree key-value engine that serves as the storage layer for countless databases. - [LevelDB](https://github.com/google/leveldb) - Google's classic embedded key-value store, still studied as the reference LSM implementation. - [BadgerDB](https://github.com/dgraph-io/badger) - A fast pure-Go embeddable LSM key-value store for local persistence. - [Pebble](https://github.com/cockroachdb/pebble) - CockroachDB's RocksDB-inspired storage engine in Go, a clean reference for modern LSM design. - [etcd](https://github.com/etcd-io/etcd) - The distributed, strongly-consistent key-value store that backs Kubernetes. - [Redis](https://github.com/redis/redis) - The ubiquitous in-memory data structure server for caching, queues, and real-time data. - [Valkey](https://github.com/valkey-io/valkey) - The Linux Foundation's Redis fork that became the community standard after Redis's license change. - [Dragonfly](https://github.com/dragonflydb/dragonfly) - A multi-threaded, Redis/Memcached-compatible in-memory store with far higher per-node throughput. - [libSQL](https://github.com/tursodatabase/libsql) - Turso's open-contribution SQLite fork adding replication and server features. - [Turso Database](https://github.com/tursodatabase/turso) - A ground-up SQLite rewrite in Rust with concurrent writes and async I/O. - [SurrealDB](https://github.com/surrealdb/surrealdb) - A multi-model (document/graph/relational) database in Rust designed to collapse the backend data layer. - [Neo4j](https://github.com/neo4j/neo4j) - The leading native graph database for connected-data workloads like fraud detection and knowledge graphs. ## 🌊 Data Engineering & Pipelines - [Apache Airflow](https://github.com/apache/airflow) - The most widely deployed workflow orchestrator for authoring and scheduling data pipelines. - [Dagster](https://github.com/dagster-io/dagster) - An asset-oriented orchestrator with strong typing, testing, and lineage that pros favor over Airflow. - [Prefect](https://github.com/PrefectHQ/prefect) - Pythonic, dynamic workflow orchestration with a modern hybrid execution model. - [dbt Core](https://github.com/dbt-labs/dbt-core) - The transformation-layer standard for version-controlled, tested SQL analytics engineering. - [Apache Spark](https://github.com/apache/spark) - The dominant distributed engine for large-scale batch and streaming data processing. - [Apache Flink](https://github.com/apache/flink) - The reference stateful stream-processing engine for low-latency, exactly-once pipelines. - [Polars](https://github.com/pola-rs/polars) - A blazing-fast, multi-threaded Rust DataFrame library increasingly replacing pandas for performance. - [Apache Arrow](https://github.com/apache/arrow) - The columnar in-memory format and IPC standard underpinning the modern data stack. - [dlt](https://github.com/dlt-hub/dlt) - A Python-first, code-driven EL library for loading data into warehouses with schema evolution. - [Apache Iceberg](https://github.com/apache/iceberg) - An open table format bringing ACID, schema evolution, and time travel to data lakes. - [Delta Lake](https://github.com/delta-io/delta) - A storage layer adding ACID transactions and versioning to lakehouse architectures. - [Apache Hudi](https://github.com/apache/hudi) - A lakehouse platform bringing incremental processing and upserts to data lakes. - [Great Expectations](https://github.com/great-expectations/great_expectations) - A framework for validating, documenting, and profiling data quality. - [SQLFluff](https://github.com/sqlfluff/sqlfluff) - The dialect-flexible SQL linter and formatter for keeping analytics code clean in CI. - [Airbyte](https://github.com/airbytehq/airbyte) - An open-source ELT platform with the largest catalog of data connectors. - [Ibis](https://github.com/ibis-project/ibis) - A portable Python dataframe API that compiles to 20+ SQL and dataframe backends. - [Apache Beam](https://github.com/apache/beam) - A unified programming model for portable batch and streaming pipelines across runners. - [PRQL](https://github.com/PRQL/prql) - A pipelined relational query language that compiles to SQL for more maintainable analytics. ## 📡 Message Queues, Streaming & Event-Driven - [Apache Kafka](https://github.com/apache/kafka) - The dominant distributed event-streaming platform and the backbone of most event-driven architectures. - [Redpanda](https://github.com/redpanda-data/redpanda) - A Kafka-API-compatible streaming engine in C++ with no ZooKeeper/JVM, valued for latency and simplicity. - [NATS Server](https://github.com/nats-io/nats-server) - A tiny, ultra-fast messaging system with JetStream persistence, popular for microservice and edge messaging. - [RabbitMQ](https://github.com/rabbitmq/rabbitmq-server) - The versatile, protocol-rich message broker that remains a default for reliable task queues. - [Apache Pulsar](https://github.com/apache/pulsar) - A streaming/messaging platform with separated compute and storage, multi-tenancy, and geo-replication. - [Temporal](https://github.com/temporalio/temporal) - A durable execution platform for writing fault-tolerant, long-running workflows as ordinary code. - [Cadence](https://github.com/cadence-workflow/cadence) - Uber's durable workflow orchestration engine (Temporal's predecessor) for long-running business logic. - [Apache RocketMQ](https://github.com/apache/rocketmq) - A high-throughput, low-latency distributed messaging and streaming platform proven at Alibaba scale. - [Debezium](https://github.com/debezium/debezium) - The standard change-data-capture platform for streaming database changes into Kafka and beyond. - [Redpanda Connect (Benthos)](https://github.com/redpanda-data/connect) - A declarative stream processor for glue-code-free data plumbing and transformation. - [RisingWave](https://github.com/risingwavelabs/risingwave) - A Postgres-compatible streaming database for building real-time materialized views in SQL. - [NSQ](https://github.com/nsqio/nsq) - A realtime distributed messaging platform in Go designed for simplicity, scale, and no SPOF. ## ⚡ LLM Serving & Inference - [vLLM](https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm) - The high-throughput PagedAttention serving engine that is the de facto open-source production inference standard. - [SGLang](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang) - A fast serving framework with RadixAttention prefix caching, prized for structured generation and low latency. - [llama.cpp](https://github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp) - The C/C++ GGUF inference engine enabling efficient CPU/GPU/Apple-silicon local LLM deployment. - [Ollama](https://github.com/ollama/ollama) - The most popular local model runner, giving a clean CLI/API over llama.cpp with model management. - [TensorRT-LLM](https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM) - NVIDIA's compiler and runtime for squeezing maximum throughput out of Tensor Core GPUs. - [Text Generation Inference](https://github.com/huggingface/text-generation-inference) - Hugging Face's production Rust/Python inference server that powered many hosted endpoints. - [LMDeploy](https://github.com/InternLM/lmdeploy) - InternLM's toolkit for compressing and serving LLMs with high-performance TurboMind kernels. - [LightLLM](https://github.com/ModelTC/lightllm) - A pure-Python, token-attention serving framework favored for lightweight, hackable high-concurrency inference. - [KTransformers](https://github.com/kvcache-ai/ktransformers) - A framework for running huge MoE models on limited GPU/CPU hardware via offloading and kernel injection. - [Aphrodite Engine](https://github.com/PygmalionAI/aphrodite-engine) - A vLLM-derived engine focused on high-throughput serving with broad quantization support. - [LocalAI](https://github.com/mudler/LocalAI) - A drop-in OpenAI-compatible API for self-hosted text, image, and audio models across many backends. - [Text Embeddings Inference](https://github.com/huggingface/text-embeddings-inference) - A blazing-fast Rust server for embedding and reranker models, a key RAG-stack component. - [NVIDIA Dynamo](https://github.com/ai-dynamo/dynamo) - A datacenter-scale distributed inference framework with disaggregated prefill/decode serving. - [llamafile](https://github.com/Mozilla-Ocho/llamafile) - A Mozilla project that packages a model and runtime into a single cross-platform executable. - [exo](https://github.com/exo-explore/exo) - Runs a single large model as a distributed cluster across everyday devices. ## 🧩 LLM App Frameworks & Orchestration - [LangChain](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langchain) - The most widely adopted LLM app framework and integration layer for chains, tools, and retrieval. - [LlamaIndex](https://github.com/run-llama/llama_index) - The data framework specializing in ingestion, indexing, and retrieval for production RAG. - [LangGraph](https://github.com/langchain-ai/langgraph) - A graph-based runtime for stateful, human-in-the-loop agent workflows; the enterprise orchestration favorite. - [DSPy](https://github.com/stanfordnlp/dspy) - A Stanford framework that programs and auto-optimizes prompts/weights instead of hand-tuning strings. - [Haystack](https://github.com/deepset-ai/haystack) - deepset's modular, production-grade pipeline framework for RAG and search applications. - [LiteLLM](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm) - A universal proxy/SDK giving one OpenAI-format interface to 100+ model providers with cost tracking. - [Dify](https://github.com/langgenius/dify) - An open-source, visual low-code platform for building and operating LLM apps and agents. - [Langflow](https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow) - A visual builder for RAG and multi-agent flows with a Python backend. - [Flowise](https://github.com/FlowiseAI/Flowise) - A drag-and-drop UI for assembling LLM orchestration flows. - [Semantic Kernel](https://github.com/microsoft/semantic-kernel) - Microsoft's enterprise SDK for planners, plugins, and agent orchestration across .NET/Python. - [Pydantic AI](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic-ai) - A type-safe, Pydantic-native agent framework for structured, validated LLM outputs. - [Mastra](https://github.com/mastra-ai/mastra) - A TypeScript-first framework for agents, workflows, and RAG, popular in the JS/edge ecosystem. - [Portkey Gateway](https://github.com/Portkey-AI/gateway) - A fast open-source AI gateway with routing, fallbacks, caching, and observability. - [Guidance](https://github.com/guidance-ai/guidance) - A constrained-generation language for interleaving control flow with token-level structure. - [Outlines](https://github.com/dottxt-ai/outlines) - A structured generation library guaranteeing JSON-schema/regex/CFG-valid LLM outputs. - [BAML](https://github.com/BoundaryML/baml) - A domain-specific language for building reliable, type-safe, testable LLM functions. - [Vercel AI SDK](https://github.com/vercel/ai) - The TypeScript toolkit for building AI apps and agents across many providers. ## 🤖 AI Agents & Multi-Agent Systems - [AutoGen](https://github.com/microsoft/autogen) - Microsoft's multi-agent conversation framework and a research staple. - [CrewAI](https://github.com/crewAIInc/crewAI) - A lean framework for orchestrating role-playing agent "crews" with minimal boilerplate. - [OpenHands](https://github.com/All-Hands-AI/OpenHands) - An autonomous software-engineering agent platform (formerly OpenDevin) that writes, runs, and tests code. - [MetaGPT](https://github.com/geekan/MetaGPT) - A multi-agent framework that simulates a software company with role-based SOPs. - [OpenAI Agents SDK](https://github.com/openai/openai-agents-python) - A lightweight, provider-agnostic framework for multi-agent workflows with handoffs and guardrails. - [smolagents](https://github.com/huggingface/smolagents) - Hugging Face's minimalist code-writing agent library. - [Google ADK](https://github.com/google/adk-python) - Google's Agent Development Kit for building, evaluating, and deploying production agents. - [CAMEL](https://github.com/camel-ai/camel) - A research framework for communicative and role-playing multi-agent systems at scale. - [Agno](https://github.com/agno-agi/agno) - A high-performance framework/runtime for agents with memory, knowledge, and tools (formerly Phidata). - [SWE-agent](https://github.com/SWE-agent/SWE-agent) - Princeton's benchmark-topping agent that autonomously resolves GitHub issues. - [Skyvern](https://github.com/Skyvern-AI/skyvern) - Automates browser workflows using vision-LLMs that read pages via screenshots. - [Stagehand](https://github.com/browserbase/stagehand) - An AI browser-automation SDK blending natural language with code for reliable web agents. - [LiveKit Agents](https://github.com/livekit/agents) - A framework for building real-time, low-latency voice and multimodal AI agents. - [ChatDev](https://github.com/OpenBMB/ChatDev) - A multi-agent virtual software company for collaborative code generation. - [E2B](https://github.com/e2b-dev/E2B) - Open-source secure cloud sandboxes for running AI-generated code. ## 🔎 RAG, Vector Databases & Agent Memory - [Milvus](https://github.com/milvus-io/milvus) - A cloud-native vector database engineered for billion-scale similarity search. - [Qdrant](https://github.com/qdrant/qdrant) - A Rust vector database praised for fast filtered search and simple production operations. - [Weaviate](https://github.com/weaviate/weaviate) - A vector database with strong hybrid search and a built-in module ecosystem. - [Chroma](https://github.com/chroma-core/chroma) - A developer-friendly embedding database that is the default for fast RAG prototyping. - [pgvector](https://github.com/pgvector/pgvector) - The Postgres extension that adds vector search, the pragmatic default for teams already on Postgres. - [LanceDB](https://github.com/lancedb/lancedb) - An embedded, multimodal vector database built on the columnar Lance format. - [FAISS](https://github.com/facebookresearch/faiss) - Meta's foundational library for efficient similarity search and vector clustering. - [Marqo](https://github.com/marqo-ai/marqo) - An end-to-end vector search engine with first-class multimodal embedding generation. - [RAGFlow](https://github.com/infiniflow/ragflow) - An end-to-end RAG engine with deep document understanding and agentic context construction. - [GraphRAG](https://github.com/microsoft/graphrag) - Microsoft's knowledge-graph-based RAG approach for global reasoning over large corpora. - [Graphiti](https://github.com/getzep/graphiti) - Builds real-time, temporally-aware knowledge graphs for agent memory. - [cognee](https://github.com/topoteretes/cognee) - A memory/knowledge-graph layer that replaces ad-hoc RAG with structured pipelines. - [txtai](https://github.com/neuml/txtai) - An all-in-one embeddings database for semantic search, RAG, and LLM workflows. - [Unstructured](https://github.com/Unstructured-IO/unstructured) - A preprocessing library that turns PDFs, HTML, and docs into clean, chunked LLM data. - [Mem0](https://github.com/mem0ai/mem0) - A universal memory layer giving agents persistent user/session/agent-scoped memory. - [Letta](https://github.com/letta-ai/letta) - An agent framework (formerly MemGPT) treating memory like an OS with self-managed context. ## 🎛️ Model Fine-Tuning & Training - [Transformers](https://github.com/huggingface/transformers) - The foundational model library and hub interface underpinning most modern LLM work. - [Unsloth](https://github.com/unslothai/unsloth) - Custom Triton kernels that make LoRA/QLoRA fine-tuning 2x+ faster with far less VRAM. - [Axolotl](https://github.com/axolotl-ai-cloud/axolotl) - A config-driven fine-tuning framework favored for reproducible, production training pipelines. - [LLaMA-Factory](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory) - A unified, GUI-friendly fine-tuning platform supporting 100+ models and every major PEFT method. - [PEFT](https://github.com/huggingface/peft) - Hugging Face's parameter-efficient fine-tuning library (LoRA, adapters, prompt tuning) used everywhere. - [TRL](https://github.com/huggingface/trl) - A post-training toolkit unifying SFT, DPO, GRPO, and RLHF trainers on the HF stack. - [Megatron-LM](https://github.com/NVIDIA/Megatron-LM) - NVIDIA's reference for large-scale tensor/pipeline-parallel transformer pretraining. - [DeepSpeed](https://github.com/microsoft/DeepSpeed) - Microsoft's ZeRO-based training/inference optimization library for training massive models. - [Accelerate](https://github.com/huggingface/accelerate) - A thin abstraction for launching PyTorch training across multi-GPU/TPU/mixed-precision setups. - [Diffusers](https://github.com/huggingface/diffusers) - The standard toolkit for training and running diffusion models for image/audio/video. - [OpenRLHF](https://github.com/OpenRLHF/OpenRLHF) - A Ray-based, high-performance RLHF framework for scalable PPO/GRPO alignment training. - [verl](https://github.com/verl-project/verl) - Volcano Engine's flexible RL post-training library (HybridFlow), a 2026 favorite. - [ms-swift](https://github.com/modelscope/ms-swift) - ModelScope's framework for fine-tuning and deploying 400+ LLMs/MLLMs. - [XTuner](https://github.com/InternLM/xtuner) - An efficient, flexible toolkit for fine-tuning LLMs and multimodal models. - [LitGPT](https://github.com/Lightning-AI/litgpt) - 20+ from-scratch LLM implementations with pretrain/finetune/deploy recipes. ## 🧪 LLM Evaluation, Observability & Guardrails - [Langfuse](https://github.com/langfuse/langfuse) - An open-source LLM engineering platform for tracing, evals, and prompt management; the observability leader. - [Ragas](https://github.com/explodinggradients/ragas) - A reference-free RAG evaluation library that pioneered faithfulness/relevancy metrics. - [DeepEval](https://github.com/confident-ai/deepeval) - "Pytest for LLMs" with 50+ metrics and CI/CD-friendly unit testing of model outputs. - [Phoenix](https://github.com/Arize-ai/phoenix) - Arize's OpenTelemetry-native, self-hostable tracing and evaluation tool for LLM/agent apps. - [Guardrails](https://github.com/guardrails-ai/guardrails) - Adds input/output validators and structured-output guarantees around LLM calls. - [NeMo Guardrails](https://github.com/NVIDIA/NeMo-Guardrails) - NVIDIA's toolkit for adding programmable safety/topical rails to conversational apps. - [OpenAI Evals](https://github.com/openai/evals) - The widely-used framework and registry for building and running model evaluations. - [lm-evaluation-harness](https://github.com/EleutherAI/lm-evaluation-harness) - EleutherAI's de facto harness for academic LLM benchmarking. - [promptfoo](https://github.com/promptfoo/promptfoo) - A CLI/library for test-driven prompt evaluation and LLM red-teaming/security scanning. - [lighteval](https://github.com/huggingface/lighteval) - Hugging Face's lightweight, all-in-one evaluation suite across multiple backends. - [Giskard](https://github.com/Giskard-AI/giskard) - A testing framework that scans ML/LLM systems for vulnerabilities, bias, and robustness issues. - [LLM Guard](https://github.com/protectai/llm-guard) - A security toolkit for defending against prompt injection and data leakage. - [OpenLLMetry](https://github.com/traceloop/openllmetry) - OpenTelemetry-based instrumentation for end-to-end LLM app observability. - [Helicone](https://github.com/Helicone/helicone) - An open-source LLM observability proxy for logging, caching, and cost monitoring. - [Opik](https://github.com/comet-ml/opik) - Comet's open-source platform for tracing, evaluating, and monitoring LLM applications. ## 📦 MLOps & Experiment Tracking - [MLflow](https://github.com/mlflow/mlflow) - The de facto open standard for experiment tracking, model registry, and GenAI evaluation. - [Ray](https://github.com/ray-project/ray) - A distributed compute framework (Train/Tune/Serve/Data) underpinning much large-scale ML infra. - [BentoML](https://github.com/bentoml/BentoML) - A framework for packaging models and building/serving production inference APIs. - [KServe](https://github.com/kserve/kserve) - A Kubernetes-native, standardized model inference platform with autoscaling and vLLM support. - [ZenML](https://github.com/zenml-io/zenml) - An extensible MLOps/LLMOps framework for portable, reproducible pipelines across stacks. - [Weights & Biases](https://github.com/wandb/wandb) - The industry-standard experiment tracking, artifacts, and model management SDK. - [Aim](https://github.com/aimhubio/aim) - An open-source, self-hostable experiment tracker for high-volume run comparison. - [DVC](https://github.com/iterative/dvc) - Git-based data and model version control for reproducible ML pipelines. -
